FRA.evidence_note: No play data exists. Counts (removal per colour, per-pair density, mechanic distribution) are reliable; all grades are pre-game predictions.
FRA.retire_when: 17Lands GIH WR lands after the FRA Arena release; or when limited-resources/FRA.md, limited-level-ups/FRA.md, or lords-of-limited/FRA-draft-guide.md are captured
FRA.trios_variant: A — shared pool, 18 boosters (assumed; CONFIRM ON THE DAY)
FRA.trio_config: B/R + B/G + W/U — locks the consensus best pair (B/R), avoids the consensus trap (G/U), covers all five colours, doubles black across two seats. Runner-up B/R + W/B + U/G only if green and white are both empty.
key_findings: TEN two-colour archetypes, not five — allied pairs are the Hexhaven colleges, enemy pairs the Echoverse characters; Wizards documents all ten with signposts
Every pair has a DUAL LAND AT COMMON (10 total), each untapped if you control a planeswalker — and a Jace token counts
Removal by colour (LimitedMTG count, 60 total): B 14, R 11, W 7, U 5, G 5, gold/colourless 18
Consensus best pair B/R (26 castable removal); consensus trap G/U (11, fewest of any pair)
Empower Jace: 35 cards, 11 at common, all five colours, all feeding ONE shared token
Prepared is a COMMON cycle (24 cards, 10 common); three uncommons re-prepare every upkeep for a free spell per turn
Format speed normal: avg MV 3.2, 68% of spells cost <=3, 3 damage kills 68% of creatures
Draftsim's top grades cluster in red and green — 5 of 9 perfect scores

what: First draft claimed no expert reviews existed. They did — four written sources were already published; nobody had searched.
First draft's per-colour analysis covered only mono-coloured cards and skipped all 75 multicolour ones, producing a wrong structural read (five allied factions) and wrong removal counts.
First draft's mana costs were truncated to 9 characters by the dump script, understating several costs (Kwia Vigorbloom is 6 mana not 5; Aerid Konstrari 4 not 3).
corrections_applied.lesson: Search for published coverage before concluding none exists; verify a set-wide count includes gold and hybrid cards.
